# nb-studio deploy

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## deploy

Deploy an archive or a release to an App

With `sha` and `file` (`nb-studio deploy --app <app> --file dist.tar.gz`, the CLI reading the commit and the repository from CI’s environment): admits the build as `POST /api/builds/report` does (the App made already, `upload` and `deploy` on it or the repository’s CI key) and answers a one-time ticket the CLI streams the archive to; the release it becomes, or the release another App of the repository holds of the same bytes, is deployed, and the upload answers both. With `releaseId` (`nb-studio deploy --app --release <id>`, where a commit without `file` is ignored): deploys that release, the App’s own (a rollback) or one the repository uploaded to another App (promoted into it). An unprotected environment deploys at once. A protected one takes no direct deployment, from a person or from CI: it gets a deployment request for exactly that release, and the answer is still a success, with `deployment` null and `request` the pending request (`status: pending`) and its page (`url`), where an approver approves it. An App `nb-studio app ensure` made whose first deployment is an open pull request’s head becomes that pull request’s preview (`preview` in the answer).

```bash
nb-studio deploy --app <string>
```

| Flag           | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| -------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--app`        | string | The App to deploy to. (required)                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `--sha`        | string | The full commit hash the archive is built from; it must belong to the repository. (default from pull_request.head.sha of $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH or $GITHUB_SHA or $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_BRANCH_SHA or $CI_COMMIT_SHA)                                        |
| `--release`    | string | A release to deploy instead of an archive: the App’s own (a rollback), or one the repository uploaded to another App (promoted into it).                                                                                                                    |
| `--repository` | string | The repository the commit is verified in, as `owner/repo`; when none is named, the one the App was recorded or made for, else the one whose CI key the credential is. A CI key may name only its own. (default from $GITHUB_REPOSITORY or $CI_PROJECT_PATH) |
| `--file`       | path   | The archive CI built (`dist.tar.gz`), uploaded and deployed; of the commit --sha names. (streamed to an upload ticket, at most 268435456 bytes)                                                                                                             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/deploy`.

**Request:** `POST /api/builds/deploy` (`buildsDeploy`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio deploy --app my-app-pr-12 --file storage/exports/dist.tar.gz
nb-studio deploy --app my-app-staging --repository acme/my-app --sha <sha> --file dist.tar.gz
nb-studio deploy --app my-app --release <release>
```

## deploy get

Get a deployment

Requires the `view` or the `deploy` action on the App, so CI holding only a deploying key can wait for the result.

```bash
nb-studio deploy get <app> <deployment>
```

| Argument     | Description |
| ------------ | ----------- |
| `app`        |             |
| `deployment` |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `rel.apps/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/apps/{appId}/deployments/{deploymentId}` (`releasesGetDeployment`)

## deploy list

List an app's deployments

Requires the `view` action on the App.

```bash
nb-studio deploy list <app>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag      | Type    | Description  |
| --------- | ------- | ------------ |
| `--page`  | integer | (default 1)  |
| `--limit` | integer | (default 20) |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `kind`, `status`, `phase`, `release.version`, `createdAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `rel.apps/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/apps/{appId}/deployments` (`releasesListDeployments`)

## deploy logs

Read a deployment's logs

Requires the `read-logs` action on the App. Read like the App logs: one bounded JSON chunk per request, continued with `pageToken`; `meta.status` and `meta.phase` report the deployment’s progress.

```bash
nb-studio deploy logs <app> <deployment>
```

| Argument     | Description |
| ------------ | ----------- |
| `app`        |             |
| `deployment` |             |

| Flag           | Type     | Description |
| -------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `--page-token` | string   |             |
| `--level`      | trace \\ | debug \\    | info \\ | warn \\ | error \\ | fatal |     |
| `--source`     | string   |             |
| `--search`     | string   |             |
| `--since`      | string   |             |
| `--until`      | string   |             |
| `--from-start` | boolean  |             |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `time`, `level`, `msg`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `rel.apps/read-logs`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/apps/{appId}/deployments/{deploymentId}/logs` (`releasesReadDeploymentLogs`)

## deploy reopen-suggestion decide

Answer a suggestion to reopen issues

Only for the person the suggestion was sent to, after a deployment of the App no longer runs what finished issues shipped. `reopen` moves each listed issue still done back, as the caller; `dismiss` leaves them done. Either settles the suggestion.

```bash
nb-studio deploy reopen-suggestion decide <app> --action <string>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag       | Type      | Description |
| ---------- | --------- | ----------- |
| `--action` | reopen \\ | dismiss     | (required) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/deploys/reopenSuggestions/{appId}/decide` (`deploysDecideReopenSuggestion`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio deploy reopen-suggestion decide my-app --action reopen
```

## deploy request

Request a deployment

Requires the `deploy` action on the App. Asks for `releaseId` to be deployed, or with `rollbackToDeploymentId` for a rollback, to be approved by one of the environment’s approvers. On a protected environment this is the only way to deploy.

```bash
nb-studio deploy request <app>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag            | Type   | Description                           |
| --------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `--release`     | string |                                       |
| `--rollback-to` | string |                                       |
| `--note`        | string | (or --note-file <path>)               |
| `--label`       | json   | A label (key=value); repeat for more. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `rel.apps/deploy`.

**Request:** `POST /api/releases/apps/{appId}/deploymentRequests` (`releasesCreateDeploymentRequest`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio deploy request my-app --release <release> --note "Ready for production"
```

## deploy request approve

Approve a deployment request

One of the environment’s approvers (with none named, a person holding `deploy-protected` on the App), other than the requester. Approving deploys the release the request fixed; `confirm` repeats the App ID on a protected environment.

```bash
nb-studio deploy request approve <request>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `request` |             |

| Flag        | Type    | Description                                               |
| ----------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--note`    | string  | (or --note-file <path>)                                   |
| `--confirm` | string  | The App ID again, for a protected environment.            |
| `--yes`     | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Approve and deploy the release?” |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/releases/deploymentRequests/{requestId}/approve` (`releasesApproveDeploymentRequest`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio deploy request approve <request> --note "Checked on staging"
```

## deploy request list

List deployment requests

Any signed-in caller; lists the requests on Apps they may view or requests they may decide. `awaitingMe=true` lists the pending requests the caller may decide.

```bash
nb-studio deploy request list
```

| Flag            | Type       | Description  |
| --------------- | ---------- | ------------ |
| `--page`        | integer    | (default 1)  |
| `--limit`       | integer    | (default 20) |
| `--app`         | string     |              |
| `--status`      | pending \\ | approved \\  | rejected \\ | cancelled \\ | deployed \\ | failed |     |
| `--awaiting-me` | boolean    |              |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `appId`, `environmentId`, `kind`, `status`, `createdAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/deploymentRequests` (`releasesListDeploymentRequests`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio deploy request list --awaiting-me true
```


## deploy status

Read what runs on a project’s environments

For whoever sees the project: what runs on each staging and production App of its repositories, and who approved it.

```bash
nb-studio deploy status <project>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `project` |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/deploys/projects/{projectId}/environments` (`deploysGetProjectEnvironments`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio deploy status <project>
```
